title: Fast SDP certification of neural networks : towards large multi-class datasets
summary: We present a new quadratic model for the certification problem in adversarial robustness, which simultaneously accounts for all possible target classes. Building on this model, we propose a novel semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxation for incomplete verification. A key advantage of our approach is that it certifies robustness in a single optimization, avoiding the need for a separate resolution per class. This yields a significant computational speed-up and enables scalability to large datasets with many classes. To further improve efficiency, we also propose an effective pruning strategy…
